title: Versioned writing limits
responsibility: Counts note and commit text consistently and reports length violations under the revision’s declared writing policy.

inputs.name: writingHeld.config
inputs.description: Verification-config JSON text, or undefined when absent.

inputs.name: writingDeclared.config
inputs.description: Verification-config JSON text to check for an applicable numeric writing version.

inputs.name: writingCount.text
inputs.description: Text to trim, normalize line endings and count.

inputs.name: writingProblems.field
inputs.description: Field label to include in any violation message.

inputs.name: writingProblems.text
inputs.description: Text to measure against the supplied bounds.

inputs.name: writingProblems.limit
inputs.description: Character limit and optional word limit; null word limit means no word-count cap.

inputs.name: explanationProblems.reason
inputs.description: Unit/symbol reason with behavior and simplification/performance attempt text.

inputs.name: explanationProblems.version
inputs.description: Policy version of the revision the reason explains.

outputs.name: writingLimits
outputs.description: Shared bounds: behavior 30 words/200 characters; legacy attempt 20/140; subject 72 characters; body 60/400.

outputs.name: writingPolicy
outputs.description: Bounds for the requested version, reducing attempt words to 15 under version 2.

outputs.name: writingHeld
outputs.description: Highest supported version not above the numeric declaration, or null for absent/invalid/below-one declarations; future versions use the newest supported policy.

outputs.name: writingDeclared
outputs.description: True when writingHeld finds an applicable policy.

outputs.name: writingCount
outputs.description: Whitespace-delimited words and Unicode-code-point characters after trimming and CR/LF normalization.

outputs.name: writingProblems
outputs.description: Empty-field or exceeded word/character messages, or an empty list when within bounds.

outputs.name: explanationProblems
outputs.description: Behavior and attempt violations prefixed with unit and symbol, using whole-unit naming for *.
